about_text: Licensed, bonded, insured, and operating at reasonable rates, JMart Pool Service has been in business since 2010, delivering excellent services to all its clients. We also give free estimates on our work and discounts to new customers.

testimonials.name: Julie X.
testimonials.text: Best pool service provider, go to person I have used services from Jmart for years! They are the life saver! Services always done super professionally with reasonable price, be it pool filter cleaning or Salt call cleaning. Technician is definitely very knowledgeable in pool business and always have answer for me for any questions I have, explains with detail and patience, very good customer service! Technician is also very observing, and notice small changes and future to watch out items, someone you can trust your pool and equipments with! I strongly recommend Jmart service to any pool owners!

testimonials.name: Zulema V.
testimonials.text: Amazing Work!! I hired this company 5 months ago and I am so happy with the results. They are honest and responsible my pool has never been so clean! I truly recommend their services.

testimonials.text: I hired this company for its swimming pool maintenance services and I am quite impressed. I recommend these specialists for they are truly reliable and very skilled. Thank you for everything!
